title.native: 継母の連れ子が元カノだった
title.romaji: Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta

109423.description: Yamada Kiki is a high school girl who fights against monsters, she's trained every day by Gohma her childhood friend.

109425.description:
The day another world erodes Tokyo, the capital becomes a battlefield. Where is the limit of battle?

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: 東京×異世界戦争 自衛隊、異界生物を迎撃せよ
title.romaji: Tokyo×Isekai Sensou: Jieitai, Ikai Seibutsu wo Geigeki Seyo

109426.description:
After being caught kissing his senpai, Umegaki Kaoru is ready to do anything to make Yajima keep his secret, but instead of being extorted as he was expecting, Yajima asks him to become his friend.

Just what could he be planning?

title.native: 矢嶋くんの専属フレンド

109427.description: Just because he tried to be a cheapskate and scan a QR code that he thought was for a business promotion, the Li Ming Yang who was rushing to be on time for his date with his girlfriend was sent to a mysterious place...

109428.description:
Scarlett was a happy girl. With beautiful looks, a wealthy family, and even a kind fiancee, Scarlett was expected to be the most beautiful bride in the world. But on the morning of her wedding day, the pure-white bride was killed by someone. When she opened her eyes again, everything was different.

“I’ve told you many times before. It’s because I’m Scarlett Antwerp!”
“I’m sorry, but the Esteemed Daughter of the Count, Lady Antwerp, is already dead.”

Waking up in a strange place, Scarlett could not understand what had happened to her. Why couldn’t anyone recognize her? Why was her fiancee standing next to another woman? Why was she Vivian instead of Scarlett, the Esteemed Daughter of the Count? Why was the one next to her not her fiancee Edward, but Alexis, the police chief? Scarlett swore that she’d get her fiancé back and get revenge on the one who killed her.

109429.description:
Once upon a time, there was a handsome king who was greedy and cruel. When God reviewed the record of his life, God shook his head and asked the three women who suffered the most because of the king, "What punishment would you like him to receive?" The three women, glancing at one another, answered in unison, "Please send all of us back to Earth."

The women took away his beauty, his swordsmanship, and his uncaring attitude, and the king is reincarnated as Ji-En the maid. The three women are reborn as men, and when they meet Ji-En, the tangled relationships from their past life reemerge…!

"What did I do in my past life to deserve this mess!"

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)
synonyms: หวนคืนรักจักรพรรดิทรราช

109430.description:
Hye-in is a quiet, introspective high school senior. As an aspiring art major, she hones her skills in the art club. When a handsome new T.A. named Mr. Lee starts at the club, Hye-in’s curiosity awakens. Mr. Lee’s talented, popular and sensitive. So why on earth has he taken such an interest in her? In the complex world of high school, things are never how they appear. It all depends on how you look at them…

(Source: Lezhin US)

109431.description: Melty Blood: Rojiura Nightmare is a spin-off and sequel to the Melty Blood fighting games and manga, as well as the Fate/Grand Order mobile game.
synonyms: Melty Blood - Back Alley Alliance Nightmare

title.native: MELTY BLOOD 路地裏ナイトメア

109432.description:
"Only I can remember what everybody else forgot."

A collection of very short stories, almost poems, focused on a woman who takes on different roles. Surrealistic, slice-of-life, psychological, and sci-fi themes coexist in this volume, expressed in pale, ethereal hues.

(Source: Star Comics, translated)

109433.description: This one shot takes place between chapter 2 and 3 and was made to promote Jigokuraku.

109434.description: Wendy is a reclusive florist who doesn’t believe in love. That is until he came in, ready to destroy the walls caging her heart.
synonyms: Don't Go to Wendy the Florist
ウェンディの花屋に来ないで

109435.description:
Set on a path to tragedy and misfortune from a young age, Aseph Randell is doomed to die a villain. That is, until the mysterious Elzay Tiathe appears in his life with a promise: "I can save you." After having vivid visions of him for so long, can Elzay untangle the twisted fate tied to Aseph... or will they both be dragged down together? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: TappyToon)

109436.description:
The Speràdo family line possesses a secret: shadow magic. But it’s been 100 years since someone last wielded it. When Marquis Speràdo tries to sacrifice Leslie for her favored sister Ellie, little does he know that this awakens the power of darkness in her instead. To escape her family’s greed and abuse, Leslie’s out to make a deal with the Monstrous Duke: adopt her, and her powers will be at the duke’s disposal. Will Leslie escape her parents’ cruel grip, or succumb to their evil exploits?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 20 extra stories.
synonyms: The Monster Duchess and Contract Princess

109437.description: Kang Jun, a prince of a small nation of the East, was taken as a hostage after his country was defeated by the West. There he meets Rosaline, the Queen who held great power and has absolute sovereignty over the country. As Rosaline’s spoils of war, she took him for herself and now lives in her castle. One day, however, Kang Jun discovered Rosaline’s political secret. And instead of keeping her secret, Kang Jun takes advantage of it and tries to use her power to rebuild his own country.

109438.description:
Lucia, the sixteenth princess of the kingdom, has seen her future through a strange dream. But it was a vivid nightmare of a terrible marriage that continues to haunt her. To change her dreadful fate, she suggests a contract marriage to Duke Hugo Taran, a well-known womanizer. Can this setup break Lucia from her fate? Or will her choice lead down a path even she couldn't foresee?! Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: ลูเซีย เจ้าหญิงผู้ถูกลืม
露西亚 - 攻略公爵计划

109439.description:
What would you do for $500k? As a struggling actress, I agreed to play the part of Doting Fiancée to Jeekyung Lee, a charming, handsome heir to a Korean conglomerate—the perfect husband! Except, he’s gay. Eh, it’s fine! The only problem is... (cue ominous music) Jeehan, Jeekyung’s younger brother. That jerk may have the looks of a leading man, but he’s determined to show I’m the wrong girl for Jeekyung! It’s gonna take the performance of my life to win him over. Hah! I’m ready for my Oscar!

(Source: Tapas)

109440.description:
By day Bo-Ram Eom is a secretary, but by night she’s secretly a children’s storybook author under the pen name Bo-Ram. Too talented to be just an office worker, she created The Child with A Mask to escape her terrible boss, Se-Hu Kwon. Sure, he’s attractive, intelligent, but he’s also super rude! And now, he wants to find the creator of the book. How long can she keep her identity secret? And why does her boss want to meet her…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

109441.description:
How far would you go to take down the person you hate most? With no house, no job, and nothing left to lose, Geun-Yeong Lee is willing to risk it all to bring down the country’s national treasure, Korean superstar Who-Joon. But once the two really get to know each other, bringing him down suddenly becomes a lot harder. Will she be able to ruin him once and for all after she learns the truth about the man behind the popstar?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes prologue and special epilogue chapters.
synonyms: だから俺はアンチと結婚 した
แอนตี้แฟนกับนายท็อปสตาร์จอมเฟค

109442.description: "Hongshi Loves Me!" tells the exciting school life of a 20-year-old 12th grader! Look forward to a school campus sitcom full of affection!
synonyms: 柿本くんはかわいいっ！

109443.description:
All’s fair in love and war… If you are who you say you are. Meet Elijah (Avery), the Earl of Baenbowie’s footman. By day, he attends to the household, running errands for the Earl and being teased endlessly by him, too. By night, Elijah dreams of the day she can stop pretending to be a boy and finally be the girl under her short haircut and men’s waistcoat. But as her feelings for the Earl keep growing and the Crowned Prince is suspicious of her secret, will she make it to her 18th birthday unscathed?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

109444.description:
Class representative Marui, an ordinary high school boy, finds Hachiyo face-down by a river bed. Even though Hachiyo was regarded as the school’s strongest delinquent, Marui secretly has a crush on her. However, when Hachiyo wakes up, she suddenly can’t remember anything about herself?

Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

title.native: ニセ記憶喪失の蜂夜さん

109446.description: To Lady Takashima, the breach of etiquette is deserving of the death sentence. As the hate towards the lack of manners arises within her, the feeling of "I want to try it" has also arisen within her. This work is the record of the daily life of the Ojou-sama struggling with her guilt.
synonyms: The Secret Etiquette of Lady Takashima.

title.native: 御令嬢高嶋清乃は密かに嗜む
title.romaji: Goreijou Takashima Kiyono wa Hisoka ni Tashinamu.

109447.description:
On her first day of work, Asou is assigned the cold and demeaning Mochizuki as her sempai. At first, Mochizuki treats her horribly, making her run errands and take care of her pets, until the day comes when Asou accidentally observes a different side to her senior.

(Source: Amazon, translated)
synonyms: Yuri Kagi ~Senpai no Himitsu wo Nozoitemita~
百合鍵 ～先輩の秘密をのぞいてみた～

109448.description: From a lineage of elite demon lords, the current demon lord Eugene Satania - Vidorick has one secret way of relaxing from the stress he accumulates in the demon world. Which is to go to the human world under the guise as the human named Sayano Yuuji, mixing into common everyday folk to enjoy himself! Now a rookie-low-class demon suddenly appeared in front of him, named Mist. With a good-for-nothing low-class demon at his side, Yuuji now has to hide his identity at all costs! Let's start this suspicious rom-com!
synonyms: I'm The Demon Lord, But Nobody Found Out Yet, Right?

title.native: オレ、魔王だけどバレてないよね?
title.romaji: Ore, Maou Dakedo Baretenai yo ne?

109449.description:
Rupia lives proudly as the daughter of a well-respected noble family. But to fulfill a prophetic oracle she and her friends, along with hundreds of other human females, will be offered up as brides for the Underworld’s demonic nobility. Upon meeting Edith, the alluring demon king himself, Rupia realizes her undesirable fate is to become his wife. With no time to mourn the life she left behind, she keeps her cool with an attitude of sheer optimism, all while maintaining a magical secret. As Rupia grows closer to Edith and uncovers the secrets of the Underworld realm, maybe being the demon king’s bride isn’t the nightmare she expected? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 60 extra chapters.
synonyms: Ningen Desuga Maou Totsugu Koto Ni Narimashita

109450.description:
The wealthy Black Dragon clan rules Shanghai, and their power knows no bounds. But for three ordinary young Koreans, life in the city is very different. Pyung-an, an art enthusiast, is working her dream job in a prestigious gallery. Yeo-rae, a talented cellist at the Music Institute, is grafting hard to make ends meet. And Jin-hwan is looking for inspiration after his dream of being a taekwondo star foundered. For these three, the vast metropolis teems with potential romance, excitement...and danger. As they become mixed up with the formidable Black Dragon family, their lives are turned upside down.

(Source: Lezhin US)

109451.description:
On her way back home late one night, office worker Sophie stumbles into another world where she's a princess?! Well that's what Alan, prince of the Lapis Kingdom, says. To return to her world she must fulfill the prophecy and help Alan become king. Sophie agrees but...amidst a war for the crown, can she survive?

(Source: Tapas)

109452.description: Decades ago, the tiny town of Hanaizawa was cut off from the rest of the world by an invisible wall, a wall that nothing living can pass through. The younger residents have grown up only knowing the outside world through what they see and hear in the media. These are the stories of their everyday lives, the good and the bad, as they live out their days in a tiny town that no one can enter and no one can leave -- a town which, by its isolated nature, is destined to fade away.

109453.description: Jun-Hyun and Na-Hyun are a brother-sister duo with an almost obsessive devotion to each other. Is it simply a case of forbidden love between siblings? Or is something more sinister at play?
synonyms: Shackles - Story of Brother and Sister

109454.description:
Ominous beings are intruding into our reality...

Park Yun-yeong has a mysterous power which allows her to see ghastly creatures that seem to inhabit our world but not interact with it - unless they notice you acknowledge their existence. That’s when they stop being harmless.

(Source: Naver, translated & edited)

109455.description:
The ghostly Hanako-kun and his mortal assistant, Nene Yashiro, usually have their hands full resolving various supernatural incidents in Kamome Academy, but how do they spend their time when they get a break from all that? Come and watch the characters of Toilet-bound Hanako-kun play games, get sick, change genders, and discover world-shaking secrets during their laid-back after-school hours!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: "Cậu" ma nhà xí Hanako - Sau giờ học

109456.description:
Though he had lost his family at a young age, through the help of Duchess Orleans and the Emperor, Karl grew up excellently. But at the banquet Karl attends to tell the Duchess of the Emperor's meaningful words, a questionable explosion takes place. Duchess, what is your true identity?!

(Source: Boomtoon, translated)

109457.description:
After he starts working as a bodyguard at the burlesque bar “Rainbow,” Kuroba meets dancer Kaede, who doesn’t look Japanese. Kaede is fascinating, yet intimidating. He is able to mesmerize the customers, which makes him one of the bar’s top dancers. On the surface he seems strong and confident, but under that mask there’s a man who knows what fear is, and Kuroba can’t help but be drawn to him. Kuroba hopes that Kaede can let him into his heart. However, because of a certain incident, Kaede has suffered a love-related trauma….?

Note: chapter count includes an extra exclusive to the online version of the volume.

109458.description: A detective, Issei Takeda, for the sake of destroying a yakuza group, surrenders his body to a yakuza member, Suguru Ishii, in order to obtain insider information. Even though Takeda has a rule where "I refuse to have a lover or a special person," the reason Ishii becomes his lover is...

109459.description: While aware he's attracted to the same sex, Takase has been living and lying because of his pride. One day, he gets to know Ito, who is always waiting for his male lover at a cafe. Takase, who was interested in how Ito always gave his true feelings to his lover, is strongly shaken by the unrelenting Ito whose tears are pure with the betrayal. However, even though he wishes to be more than friends, he can not say that he's gay.

109460.description:
Shion often calls his childhood friend Ibuki "perfect." One day, along with a mysterious voice from Heaven that declared "for being such a good child, we will take him away from this world in seven days," Shion's back blooms with feathers and a ring appears over his head. Ibuki gradually loses his senses and decides to "defile" Shion ....

The countdown is seven days until his most important person disappears.

What will happen with these two people if they fall in love on the last day?
synonyms: Last Seven Days: How to Defile an Angel

title.native: ラストセブンデイズ―天使の穢し方―
title.romaji: Last Seven Days: Tenshi no Kegashikata

109461.description:
Ever since leaving home, all Akira ever knew was how to be a pretty amazing "male host," aka a call boy. So when he opens the door to a good-looking, well-off salaryman's apartment, it doesn't take long for him to get down to business - but why is this cutie suddenly introducing him to his kid?

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: ベイビー☆ラブシッター

title.native: ベイビー★ラブシッター

109462.description:
Oono-san is a loner student, but has a secret -- somehow, she has come to be able to read minds. This would be annoying but not a problem, except for her art teacher, Nakamura -- who is head over heels in love with her.

... And is a horny pervert. A really really horny, perverted lesbian who constantly thinks about her.

109464.description:
"I think I've found a great way to relieve stress"
Naito Akira: Works at a design office. 29 years old. Work is tough. His subject of romantic interest: men. He has a policy - to never go to bed with the same person twice. After meeting the sexually inexperienced Seo at a bar, he begins giving him sex lessons to kill time. This straight man was meant to be his to ravish, but things aren't going as expected? A young, earnest ikemen and a beautiful man, romantically hurt in the past, engage in sex lessons on Friday nights.

title.native: 飼いならすはずが、喘がされて困ってます。

109465.description:
1. Maybe Darling
2. I Don't Know
3-4. Minikui Ahiru no Ko
5. Marude, Yume no Youna
synonyms: Koi wa Genjitsu Shugi de Yumemigachi

title.native: 恋は現実主義で夢みがち

109467.description:
Due to having to pay the debts of a lover who disappeared Shiki is destined to living in poverty. One night, he discovered a man who had collapsed at the park and since he was worried about him he took him home with him. The collapsed man ended up being Tenma, the extremely famous top model!! Tenma quickly hands the debt collector a large sum of money in front of a surprised Shiki and tells him “Provide service with that body – that I bought!!” and moved into the 1K (1 room + Kitchen) apartment where they started living together. Why is such a famous person living in my apartment…!? Despite being bewilderd Shiki looks after Tenma!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

109468.description:
Nobuo Hamada is a single parent who's worried his son likes men. One evening, he gets drunk at a bar and the beautiful young man, Hijiri, who has a sweet smell lingering around him, strikes a conversation with him... He wakes up in his own bed, but with Hijiri riding him and making sensual noises! it turns out Hijiri is the number one escort at a brothel!! But, Nobuo can't stop worrying about Hijiri, who seems sad and lonely, and decides to let Hijiri live with him. An office worker and an escort's love story.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Darling Cares Too Much About Me
title.native: 僕のおせっかいダーリン

109469.description:
Rio's family moved when he was a kid. Although he thought he didn't need any friends but became close with the neighbor's son, Watanabe Takeru.

Years later, they are already in high school but Rio is trying to avoid Takeru since junior high - when he realized his feelings were deeper than friendship.

109470.description: Hotta couldn't find a proper job even after graduating college two years ago, so he's still working part time at the same convenience store, he also has no friends. One day, a new part timer joins, Ryouta Kashiwagi, a young and handsome college freshman. Ryouta is popular and promising, he's on a different level, that's why Hotta is surprised to hear his sudden confession.
synonyms: You're Shining Star, I'm Clumsy Boy.
闪闪发光君与马马虎虎君

title.native: キラキラくんとイマイチくん

109471.description: Namura Tsutomu has a special condition where due to calorie consumption, he gets a raging hard-on every time he eats. He gets help to cure his irregular erections from Kaiyama and Masaki of human research institute, who find his condition fascinating. Things continue like this until he meet the handsome heir, Shiga Haruka, whose gentle touch seems to help him.

109472.description: High school teacher Yanagi Haruchika and his ex-student, host Shishida Kiyomasa, are in the middle of their honeymoon cohabitation! Contrary to his looks, Kiyomasa is meticulous both in chores and in bed, and Haruchika wonders if he can make the both of them happy, but... In the midst of this, a student of Haruchika's, Asako, suddenly enters their life...?! Can Haruchika and Kiyomasa's lovey-dovey daily life possibly survive this?

109473.description: The two of them know each other's fap material, and they even rub each other out. Such childhood friends are Junto and Sato. One day, the AV that a classmate lent them showed a**l sex! Sato, gushing with curiosity, says that he wants to try it, and begs Junto to put it in. Junto gives in to the seduction, and...!

title.native: 欲しがりちゃんのカレシ化計画
しりこだまラプソディ

109479.description:
Featured in this collection are: A yakuza/cop couple with a painful way of showing their love for each other, a guy who films AV's and his subject, a butler and his master, and an art student pining away for his senpai.

1. Gesu to Abazure (Sleazebag and Bitch)
2. Yasashii Tsuki (Sweet Moon)
3-4. Doushoumonai
5. Kare no Tame no Shitsuji

109480.description:
1. Tasogare Doki ni Mitsuketa no (たそがれ時に見つけたの); Ribon 6/1974
2. Shishiza Umare no Anata-sama (獅子座うまれのあなたさま); Ribon Fall Special Issue/1972
3. Kintarou-kun (金たろうくん); Ribon Spring Special Issue/1973
4. Oishii Koigusuri (おいしい恋グスリ); Ribon Special Summer Issue/1973
5. Wakatte Kudasai Otsuki-sama (わかって下さいお月さま); Ribon Special Fall Issue/1973
6. Manatsu no Yoru no Yume (真夏の夜の夢); Ribon Special Summer Issue/1974

title.native: たそがれ時に見つけたの

109481.description:
1. Oshaberi na Hitomi (おしゃべりな瞳); Ribon 2/1976
2. Yuki Yuki Monogatari (雪雪物語); Ribon 1/1975
3. Shinjau no? (死んじゃうの？); Ribon Special New Years Issue/1973
4. Aki no Notte (秋にのって); Ribon 10/1974
5. Happy Cake no Yakeru ma ni (ハッピーケーキの焼けるまに); Ribon 6/1975

109487.description: Light novel adaptation of DECO*27's Vocaloid song by the same name.

title.romaji: Watashi no Machi no Chiba-kun wa.

109489.description:
The manga centers on a "twisted" relationship.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 愛しています、キョーコさん。

109491.description:
A collection of one-shots by Aruko.

1. Mahou no Megane. (まほうのめがね)
2. Fragments (フラグメンツ)
3. Takane no Hana-chan (高嶺の華ちゃん)

109493.description: A parody with Black Jack and other Tezuka characters.

title.native: #こんなブラック・ジャックはイヤだ

109494.description:
Higurashi Tsugumi lost his parents and maid in a fire when he was still young. He's now 15 and a promising new writer, however, he's been stuck in a slump for the past year. He decides to go back to his old family home in order to gain inspiration by reminiscing on his happy past. Unbeknownst to him, he would be greeted with an unexpected surprise from his childhood...

Includes Chapter 7.5 "Interlude: Shoes That Don't Fit"
synonyms: The Ghost Writer of the 25th Hour

109495.description:
The manga is inspired by Tezuka's Black Jack manga, and moves the setting to an alternate world where Black Jack must struggle.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 異世界ブラック・ジャック

109496.description: A crossover between Ribbon no Kishi and Roman Holiday drawn by Mauricio de Souza for Tezucomi Magazine.
synonyms: ローマの休日✕リボンの騎士
ローマの休日/リボンの騎士

109497.description:
Rud is a tank of the Hero's Party and is said to have the highest defense ever in history. The party often does labyrinth raids, but to Rud, it means more than just a raid. To cure his beloved sister's illness, he is in search for the wish-granting treasure that might be hidden in those labyrinths. But one day, the arrogant hero kicks him from the party after an unsuccessful raid attempt, blaming it on his skills whose effects he is still unaware of. Without nowhere else to go and nothing to do, he decides to return to his hometown, where his sister is waiting. On his way there, he saves a girl who was being attacked by a monster. Unexpectedly, this girl has an extremely rare skill called "Appraisal". Thanks to her skill, Rud is able to discover the truth behind his unknown skills, which turn out to be very powerful skills. With a defense of 9999 and powerful skills, thus begins the adventure of the strongest tank, Rud!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: The Labyrinth Raids of the Ultimate Tank ~The Tank Possessing a Rare 9,999 Endurance Skill was Expelled from the Hero Party~

title.english: The Strongest Tank's Labyrinth Raids -A Tank with a Rare 9999 Resistance Skill Got Kicked from the Hero's Party-
title.native: 最強タンクの迷宮攻略　～体力9999のレアスキル持ちタンク、勇者パーティーを追放される～
title.romaji: Saikyou Tank no Meikyuu Kouryaku: Tairyoku 9999 no Rare Skill-mochi Tank, Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareru

title.native: カラーレシピ・クリア

109499.description:
Korea’s hunkiest top model Woo Tae-Young has decided to try his hand at acting once more. No more of those teen heartthrob roles, Tae-Young has his eyes set on a much more…mature role. And when he finds out his idol, the dreamy Koo Min-Ki, is set to be one of the main actors of the film, he is even more determined to get the role as his co-star. The two seem to have a natural chemistry with each other… both on and off screen. Will this end up helping their performances? Or will it cause their worlds to come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin)

Notes:
- The main story finished with chapter 84 which was published in March.
- Total chapter count includes 11 extras and 3 epilogues (one per season and one for the extras).

109500.description:
On the morning of her entrance ceremony, Kobuku, a high school girl, meets Miya, a girl who dances alone, at a shrine where she goes to pray for a happy high school life.

Through Miya, Kofuku learns about "Mikagura", a traditional form of Japanese dance, and guided by a mysterious woman she meets there, begins to follow the path of Mikagura...

109501.description:
Recently dumped, Akane is just about to quit the game she used to play with her boyfriend, when she meets Yamada in the same RPG. Yamada in real life turns out to be somewhat of a legend. The only problem is - he is ONLY interested in the game. As Akane's feelings grow, will Yamada's focus stay on the game?

(Source: Mangamo)

Note: Ninth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category
synonyms: Mi amor por Yamada está al Nv. 999
Tình yêu lvl.999 của Yamada và
Minha História de Amor com Yamada-kun Nível 999

title.english: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
title.native: 山田くんとLv999の恋をする
title.romaji: Yamada-kun to Lv999 no Koi wo Suru

109503.description:
Yasukazu is a scary-faced businessman who adores cats. One day, while in the middle of brooding over how bad he is with the female customers in cat cafes, he happens to discover one with a majority of male customers. While he unwinds with cute cats he starts falling in love with the devilishly sexy Jun who works there! Can love prevail between the scary-looking cat lover and the quirky cafe manager...? Immerse yourself in this steamy yaoi comedy and let the kitties and men wash the stress away!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Capricious Cat and a Shy Lion
title.native: 気紛れ猫と気弱なライオン
title.romaji: Kimagure Neko to Kiyowa na Lion

109504.description:
We fell in love through the camera lens---. Mimasaka, a genius with a camera, returns to his university after losing his job to assist one of his former teachers. One day he's suddenly knocked over by the strange and slightly perverted Saki, who professes that he is in love with Mimasaka's gaps. At the mercy of Saki's crazy behavior, Mimasaka oddly finds himself comforted by the passionate gaze of Saki through his camera. How long before their encounter through the viewfinder will lead them to love...? A sensitive boys love romance seen through the lens of a camera.

(Source: Manga Club)

Note: Contains an extra and the one-shot “Koibito Gokko” (恋人ごっこ)

title.native: フォトジェニック☆スーパースター

109505.description:
Fushishiba regrets being born every single day of his life. He has terrible communication skills and doesn’t think he can contribute to society. Things go even more downhill when people find out he’s gay. He relocates to a remote island research facility, where he meets Futaba, who claims to be an alien. Can this quirky, out-of-this-world guy teach him how to enjoy life to the fullest?

(Source: Manga Club)

title.english: A Death Wish and an Alien

109506.description:
Tsujido Ei, who is a flower arranger, has struggled living with his step-brother, Natsuki, who he has strong feelings for. But trying to be the "Good Younger Brother" is starting to become harder as Natsuki keeps feeling skin on skin. Out of no where Natsuki in just underwear, hugs onto me, he smells so amazing. "As your older brother, I'll take the responsibility of protecting you..." wait is this a delusion?!

A love comedy that makes the family relationship go crazy!!

(Source: Manga.club)

109507.description:
Nana, who is brought up in a rich family, is now homeless. One day, she ends up surrounded by delinquent boys. The guy who helpes her from them is the son of the Narumiya Family, who had a bad relationship with Nana's family. He is such a sadistic guy who ties Nana up, and fondles the sensitive parts of her body. She is humiliated by getting stimulated by her arch enemy. What is going to happen to Nana?

(Source: Manga-Updates)

title.english: Homeless Mistress: Sadistic Prince Ties Her Up to Keep Her
title.native: ホームレスお嬢様～ドS王子の宙吊り飼育～
title.romaji: Homeless Ojou-sama: Do-S Ouji Chuuzuri Shiiku

109508.description:
Long ago, a wolf and white deer fell in love, becoming mates for life. Deep in the mountains lies a land of people who live in harmony with wolves. Among them, those who are born with white hair are called "white deers", said to have descended from the white deer of their legends. Those with black hair are called "wolves" and the royalty of these wolves will mate with white deers for life. One day, a golden-eyed white deer is discovered locked up in the basement of a village. The Soldier who found this white deer, Ylwess, and Alta slowly begin to grow close to one another. He knows he wants to protect Alta, in all of his innocence and beauty. However, Alta is destined as a white deer to marry into royalty... How can the two confront this problem...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Shindou asks him to identify himself and explain the situation. Then the outside of the structure is displayed on a large screen, and at the same time, every passenger's cell phone starts ringing all at once. To protect her family who fell from their former glory, a girl decides to marry a man whose name she does not even know. However, before she does, her little brother commits suicide in a mysterious fire, with an old book in hand.

The Imperial Library Information Assets Management Bureau—also known as "Fukurou"—then appears before the confused girl.

According to the Fukurou, there exists books called Maremono, which exert a great influence on those who read it. Moreover, the girl gained the ability to see an "Aura" due to the incident with her brother. Despite her confusion, the girl chooses to leave the "birdcage" of her former life.

What does it mean to be human?

Ocelot, a blind knight in South America before the Spanish invasion. Yuri, a Russian chess player in the middle of the Cold War. Ena, a whale hunter in the North Pole. Three very different destinies for a single question: what do we live for? Follow the struggle of each of these three characters across the globe, outside of our social rules, Western culture and Judeo-Christian morality. A beautiful reflection on humanity.

The game is set in Goryōkan Academy, a new private senior/junior high school for girls with a vast downtown campus. This highly popular school has "another face" — a secret hidden side. It organizes and trains the special unit Fifth Force to protect the world from invisible supernatural entities known as "Oburi" that are devouring the world. Haruka is a “plain jane” who left the countryside to start her college life in Tokyo. She’s secretly in love with Kurotaki, a coworker at her part-time job, but she lacks the self-confidence to confess her feelings to him. Then she meets Hikaru, a glamorous but sharp-tongued fashionista who begrudgingly agrees to play “fairy godmother” for Haruka and help her learn to love and value herself in the process. At this school there is one young man called Iwasaki who holds almost absolute control over the school and those who attend it. Everything is going smoothly for Miyoko until one day her precious flower bed is ruined… and the one who did it was Iwasaki. She vows to not let Iwasaki get away with it and confronts him about it only to be told that she is "interesting" and given his purveyor badge. She's not sure what to make of this and only knows that it means she has caught his eye in some way… Is it inevitable that the clumsy, conceited young prince and the plain, uninteresting young janitor fall in love!?

In the past 15 years, I always thought I was just an ordinary girl. I had a horrible dream in which my papa and mama became furry animals. Unexpectedly, Li Lingdao does not release her soul, but brings her back to his apartment, heals her and lets her live at his home. At ordinary times, Li Lingdao goes out to execute various haunting tasks. At the same time, different ghosts attack Yu Xi, expecting to get the soul jade. Jin-Yoo’s life is a living hell—he’s become a hermit due to an abusive father and a traumatic bullying experience. Afraid to approach him, he photographs Young-Won from afar, the pictures he takes feeding his secret fantasies. But when Young-Won finds out, Hae-Min is forced to face the object of his desires. 109601.description:
One lady comes home from work and no one is there to welcome her. No one except three domestic cats. Even then, it's hard to say if they are happy she is back or if they are tired of waiting for food.

Living with cats is no easy task; they make a mess while running around the house, beg to eat your dinner and sometimes even give you a mean glare for no apparent reason. Cats are unreasonable like that, but even so there is happiness to be found in their company.

109602.description:
Hitoshi Arai is just an average college student with a mediocre life. During high school, he was bullied for being fat and got stressed and anxious easily. He had hoped that college would give him a fresh new start, but he remains his ordinary lone self. One night on his way home from his part-time job, Hitoshi accidentally bumps his bag of groceries into a car. He immediately inspects the car to see if he left any scratches while internally musing about Aladdin's story. He is surprised when the trunk of the car pries itself opens, revealing an intimidating figure of a man who proceeds to take advantage of Hitoshi by letting him stay at his home. Intimidated and scared, Hitoshi does what the man wants. The man introduces himself as "Mah" and thus begins complicating Hitoshi's ordinary life.

(Source: Futekiya)

109604.description:
The world has now entered the age of e-sports. Teen pro gamer Ren Azumino's motto is to win, and winning game competitions is exactly how she plans on making a living. One day, an industry rep who has taken notice of Ren's exceptional performance pays Ren a visit. His mission? Recruit Ren to enroll at Hakugo Academy under the newly established e-sports department. There, Ren meets several other students, including Mashiro Kanzaki, a novice gamer struggling to find his way in life. A coming-of-age drama following the lives of a group of misfits unfolds in the exciting world of e-sports!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

109605.description: Yuki Tachibana's planned school trip deviates off course and goes on a deserted road. When he realizes that something is amiss its already too late, all the students on the school bus are taken to another world to a mysterious facility as food for the elves. Can Yuki escape from the facility protected by magic and demons?

109606.description: In 1971, the Red Army and the League of Revolutionaries, both aiming for revolution in Japan, merged to form the "Red League." With guns in hand, they set up a hideout in the mountains, where their members gathered. However, what unfolded there was not revolutionary action, but an exchange of self-criticism and mutual discussion of each member's past words and actions, which they called "summaries." The demands for these "summaries" gradually escalated into violence, as the comrades exhausted themselves in the process of "summarizing thoughts to becoming great revolutionary fighters." What exactly was said in these "summaries"? What will become of the radicalized and isolated revolutionary movement? Naoki Yamamoto coolly depicts the story of the 60 days leading up to the "Asama Sanso" incident.

109607.description:
The Red League, an armed group aiming for revolution, was being hunted in a police investigation, and on February 19, 1972, the last five remaining members broke into Asama Sanso and holed up, taking the caretaker hostage. The "Asama Sanso Incident" shook Japan in the Showa period, as NHK and other broadcasters combined to record the highest ever viewership rating of 89.7% for the live broadcast of the siege. Naoki Yamamoto's meticulously detailed documentary dissects this incident of the United Red Army as its theme. This book completes the "Red" series!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Keitaro is ready to stop living as a shut-in. He’s starting university. He’s reconnecting with his childhood friend. He’s taking a tutoring job. And he’s not messing around with ghosts anymore. At least that’s what he thinks, until he finds out the elementary schooler he’s tutoring is an occult-obsessed genius who’s hunting down dangerous spirits and won’t stop until she’s found the one that took her mom!

(Source: VIZ Media)

A young man has left Tokyo for Istanbul to meet his mother and find his long-lost father. But instead, he finds that he's fallen headlong into somebody else's rebellion!

Jiro Manabe hasn't seen his parents since he was a child. He doesn't know what to expect, except that his mother is Turkish and his Japanese father mysteriously disappeared when he was almost too young to remember. When a stranger appears who can take Jiro to his mother, the mysteries that Jiro has come to solve only grow deeper. Is a drug-addled belly dancer Jiro's mother? Why and where did Jiro's father go? And perhaps most importantly, why are army troops trying to gun them down?

(Source: Dark Horse)

Relieved, Midori falls asleep right there on the street... only to wake up in bed with Yoshiharu! He tells her, "This is compensation for the trouble you caused." Booting up this high-functioning robot turns Riko's calm and mundane life upside-down! Although she finds him annoying, the more she watches him, the harder it gets to turn him off... Despite her best efforts, however, Minato catches the attention of her bubbly and charismatic upperclasswoman Hibiki, who wants Minato to join the band she’s forming at school and won’t take no for an answer! Will Minato be able to let go of the past and play in a band again? Can polar opposites harmonize through music? Slow jam your way into this dulcet yuri series!

The curtain boldly opens on the ultimate and extraordinary “mother-son” fantasy of Ryuuji, the young man who dreams of being an adventurer, and his overprotective mother, the demonic dragon Karma Abyss!!

synonyms: Mom, Please Do not come for adventure!
Mom, Please Don't Come Adventuring With Me!: The Boy Who Was Raised by the Ultimate Overprotective Dragon, Becomes an Adventurer With His Mother

title.english: I Can Go Adventuring by Myself, Mom!: The Son Raised by the Strongest Overprotective Dragon-Mom
title.native: 冒険に、ついてこないでお母さん！ 〜 超過保護な最強ドラゴンに育てられた息子、母親同伴で冒険者になる
title.romaji: Bouken ni, Tsuitekonaide Okaasan!: Chouka Hogo na Saikyou Dragon ni Sodaterareta Musuko, Hahaoya Douhan de Boukensha ni Naru

synonyms: Sharing Life on a Deserted Island with Elves

title.native: 無人島でエルフと共同生活
title.romaji: Mujintou De Elf to Kyoudou Seikatsu

109675.description:
Kento (30 years old), won 1 billion yen in a lottery.

In order to enjoy a nice slow life for the rest of his days, he bought a small uninhabited island off the coast of Southern Japan. However, one day he finds an unconscious woman on his beach that should not be there. When he runs up to check on her, he notices some rather sharp edges...

The behaviors Elize brought from the other world are a little bit exciting for a normal guy like Kento...

"A naive middle aged guy" and "wandering elf..." a happy cohabitation between the two of them on a resort island, begins now.
synonyms: Sharing Life on a Deserted Island with Elves

title.native: 無人島でエルフと共同生活
title.romaji: Mujintou De Elf to Kyoudou Seikatsu

109676.description: The cow Ushiharu was brought to middle school student Kiyoharu's farm. To the people around him, she appears as just a normal cow, but just to him, she appears as a sexy cow-girl...!?

synonyms: The Continuation of Sexual Instinct and the Hydrogen Bomb War

title.native: 叫べ!!マンドラゴラシャウト

109679.description: If a telepath, a clairvoyant, a vice detective, a ninja with super reflexes, a spirit medium, an oil magnate, an extremely lucky boy, and an extremely strong man were to fight it out in a rock-paper-scissors tournament, who would you bet your money on? Just because it's a simple game with simple rules doesn't mean the matches will be simple. Mind games, cheat abilities, interesting characters, great humor, this manga has it all!

title.native: アルティメットジャンケン

109680.description:
Kabuki Takitsugu is a boy that can smell people's fragrances and set them up with the perfect match. But one day, he meets Hatsune, a girl who has no fragrance at all. She asks him to match her up with somebody, and, though seemingly impossible, takes on the job.

(Source: Anime News Network)

109681.description: A short oneshot by a famous animator of various famous anime (Black Bullet, Attack on Titan, Arslan Senki, She and Her Cat).

109682.description:
Dahye is still haunted by the abuse she got from Yeonhwa. Fate has it, Dahye is able to carry out her revenge after so many years. In what ways will Dahye get her revenge, and will Yeonhwa be even affected by it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

109684.description:
Tatsumi experienced the devastating death of his family in an accident during his senior year of high school. His beloved cockatiel, Chiko, died of old age as he struggled to come to terms with this utter loss.

Tatsumi was on the verge of giving up when he got summoned to another world. There, Chiko was waiting for him, much to his confusion. Resurrected as a dazzling young girl, she was worshipped as a saintess by many, making her unrecognizable to him. And to Tatsumi's shock, she had decided to make him her fiancé!

But not everyone wanted to honor their union. The two quickly realized that they were at the center of a complex plot when opposition erupted. Join Tatsumi and Chiko as they embark on this moving journey of love and resilience.

(Source: Hanashi Media)
synonyms: My Pet Is a Holy Maiden

title.native: 俺のペットは聖女さま

109685.description:
Treated like a nobody at work and constantly dogged by his merciless colleague Yamauchi, Haruo leads a rather unfulfilling life. After work, Haruo finds solace in building doll houses, a hobby of his, when one day in the middle of crafting, a fairy leaps out of a small antique bottle he finds in the cupboard! Wrapped up in each other’s lives, Haruo begins to catch feelings for the luck-bearing fairy named Kou, but then…

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 手のひらに幸運の恋人

109686.description: The love story of a 20 year old.

109687.description: Note: Originally uploaded to Twitter and collated by Kadokawa for print release.

109688.description:
Eunsoo’s life is a fairy tale. She’s a ballerina living in New York and her romantic boyfriend just proposed to her with a huge diamond ring. So what if she didn’t get the lead role this time? All the other dancers are jealous of her perfect life, and that’s all that matters. But when Eunsoo receives a call saying her boyfriend committed suicide, her fairy tale quickly turns into a nightmare she can’t wake up from.

(Source: Lezhin)

synonyms: Crime and Punishment on the Board

109692.description:
The manga centers on female professional shougi player Nayuta Touge. On breaks during her matches, Nayuta must choose the perfect meal to eat that will give her the edge to win her match. Nayuta analyzes her food options and the food decisions of her opponents just like she analyzes every move on the shougi board.

(Source: Anime News Network)

109693.description: Two friends are off to school, when a sudden gust of wind blows one of their skirts, which caused the other friend to jump into action and hide her panties. This ended with a torn pair of panties and the only thing securing her special area to the real world is a band-aid. Now they need to salvage this situation.

109694.description:
8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

109695.description:
To save his younger sister, who is destined to die within three years, Kō Saejima joins the Corpse Management Bureau, a job that promises to earn 100 million yen in a single year…
But it turns out to be a monster-extermination workplace where 90% of new recruits die within their first year!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 屍者管理局 ブラッドサーヴァント

109696.description:
On the surface, Munetaka's a sparkly prince charming, but underneath, a depraved sadist! To support his poor family, klutzy young man Banri takes a job as a maid at the venerable Shishido family residence. Although he's constantly screwing up and crying every day, he finds an unlikely friend in the young master of the house, Munetaka, whose overwhelming princely aura and gentlemanly demeanor wins the hearts of all the girls at the mansion. Master Munetaka is there for Banri when he's down, and his kindness cheers him up. But, that all changes when a plate Banri broke turns out to be a family heirloom!! Munetaka's once-kind face turns sinister as he demands that Banri spread his legs in compensation! And thus begins Banri's new life as long-suffering victim of Master Munetaka's "innocent" bullying...

(Source: Renta!)

109697.description:
Kurihara is always in second place in his year. He is always behind Kawase, the class representative and the top, much to his frustration. Adding his parents' pressure to that, he always felt insecure and invalidated around Kawase. Every time exams are around the corner, Kurihara frequents the school clinic due to his weak physical disposition caused by his small appetite. There, Kawase chances upon him and is made aware of their apparent rivalry. Since then, Kawase can't seem to stop thinking about Kurihara.

(Source: Fantasista)

title.native: みはなだペクトライト

109698.description: 12th Gold Future Cup entry #4. A one-shot about a electrifying super speed human

109699.description:
There is a rumor, when incomprehensible, inexplicable or strange things happen, rely on "him".

Winner of the Shonen Jump 2018 Gold Future Cup.

title.native: 9番目のムサシ レッドスクランブル
9番目のムサシ サイレント ブラック

109704.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Randolph no Hanayome (ランドルフの花嫁); LaLa 1976-11
2. Kutabare Mamanee! (くたばれママネエ！); Hana to Yume 1976 #21
3. OH! Yamato Nadeshiko (OH！大和なでしこ); LaLa 1977-01
4. Hanamatsuri no Yoru (花まつりの夜); Hana to Yume 1974-06

109705.description:
Bimi-san, the young lady of the Hokura Group, and Kousaku, a salaried worker of a small company, have a completely different sense of money, but they are loving couples without worrying about that. They are always happy to eat foie gras, beef bowls, high-quality yakiniku, izakaya yakitori, but as the relationship deepens, others begin to take notice?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

109706.description:
1. Okumiya-san wa Otearai ni Iru (奥宮さんはお手洗いにいる); Angel Club 2016-12
2. Yuri-nee to no Shujuu Kanke (ゆり姉との主従関係); Angel Club 2016-08

7. Rikujoubu Ran-chan no Yuuutsu (陸上部ランちゃんの憂鬱); Angel Club 2016-06
8. Koushuu Benjo no Hanazawa-san (公衆便所の花澤さん); Angel Club 2016-03
9. Senpai Before After (センパイ・ビフォーアフター); Angel Club 2016-01

109708.description: Three friends go to a private beach owned by one of them. The owner of the private beach makes the first move and takes Takahashi into skinship. She plans to make this the first nudist and free sex beach in Japan, but before that, a threesome occurs.

109709.description: Gilbert is a shy and reserved dishwasher in a large Parisian restaurant. Although he does everything to avoid being noticed, he seems to have a particularly well-developed sense of taste and smell and a thorough knowledge of cooking... Will these talents make him a master of flavours?

109710.description:
After finding out she is to be forced into a marriage of convenience as soon as she graduates high school, Kokoro sees her life ending before her eyes at her father's wishes. And so in her final year of high school, she decides to indulge in her love of other women, and create an incredible sketchbook of lesbian romance to leave behind as her legacy. As she observes the young women of her town, she learns more about their desires, their struggles, and the unpredictable whims of love.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: ゆりでなる♥えすぽわーる

109711.description: Manga adaptation of Rashomon by Ryuunosuke Akutagawa.

109712.description:
This is the story of Tokisaki Kurumi that shouldn’t have been told——

The amnesiac young girl, Empty, who woke up in the neighboring world encounters Tokisaki Kurumi. Led by her, the place she arrived at was the school's classroom. In order to kill each other, the girls known as semi-Spirits gathered. Now then——Let’s begin our battle (date).

title.native: デート・ア・ライブ フラグメント デート・ア・バレット
title.romaji: Date A Live Fragment: Date A Bullet

109713.description: Like Excalibur, this Excelia needs to be pulled out of something... a pedestal. For Seiken-chan, the pedestal is her panties.

109714.description: Up and coming mixed-raced glamour model Alice accepts the job of a lifetime for a fashion shoot on an island unlike any other. Along with her cohorts, she must survive the family of freaks that terrorize them! The Prequel to Kichikujima.

109715.description: Follow the lives of a family whose town is cast under a spell of growing younger instead of growing older.

title.native: お気に召すまま シギサワカヤ短編集
title.romaji: Oki ni Mesu Mama: Shigisawa Kaya Tanpenshuu

109718.description:
Itonaga was bullied during middle school because he had unusually small eyes which gradually made him socially awkward. At college, when he finally thought of starting things anew, he came across his ex-bully, Sanada, popular and sociable.
With his dark past coming to haunt his present, he tries to avoid Sanada at first but finally gives up. But things unexpectedly took a shocking turn soon after? What are Sanada's true intentions? What is he really aiming at?

109719.description:
Fu Yamanaka is a high school girl. She lives with "Uncle,' who runs the "Shima Shima" coffee shop. One day, an adorable girl falls from the sky right in front of their shop! The girl, whose name is Hana, is a fox who was saved in the mountains, and she's here to repay that act of kindness. Along with her watchdog Tsugo, the two girls begin their adorable and carefree days together! This sweet comedy about repaying kindness will warm your heart!!

(Source: Manga Box)

109720.description: The story is about a young woman who's insecure about her boyish looks, and the lolita-fashion-wearing young man who gives her confidence while falling for her.

title.native: ロリータくんとイケメンさん

109721.description:
Asumi is a housewife who moves into the apartment of her dreams in a new high-rise building. She becomes friends with four other mothers through her daughter An, but then...

(Source: BeLove, translated)

109722.description:
A young girl named Sayoko fascinates people with her brilliant singing voice in the early days of the Showa era. In an effort to make people recognize her, she starts wanting to sing in talkie films. It's then that she happens to meet a piano prodigy, Asami, who disregards her singing as bad!!

The curtains rise on the birth of the story of a songstress that glitters with the dreams and love of a young girl in this historical tale.

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

109723.description: Aki Morino's new series in Be Love.

title.native: Ｈ/Ｐ ホスピタルポリスの勤務日誌
title.romaji: H/P: Hospital Police no Kinmu Nisshi

109724.description: Youko Shouji's new series in Be Love.

109726.description: Amano Mizuna, 19-years-old. Likes cute little things, but she's not very good with animals. One night, a stray dog who jumped in front of her, caused her to fall off her bike. But unlike before, this dog captivated her....?!

109727.description:
After witnessing a girl who is exposed to bullying, the guy takes a step to stand up for her. However after getting beaten, he attracts the attention of a strange talking rabbit and tells the guy about a contract with him where he can get the power to defend the girl. Here, he's given his transformation, but not with his own gender. What will this lead him to...

The story of a guy who turned into a cruel girl with strange abilities.

109728.description:
Sparks fly between the handsome descendant of a snow spirit and the oblivious coworker he has a crush on! A romantic comedy in an office setting that takes coworkers to lovers to new heights within a winter wonderland of emotions!

Himuro is a modern-day ice god, an ordinary office worker who just so happens to be the descendant of a snow spirit. He's also besotted with his coworker Fuyutsuki, who's a little unusual herself. At first glance, the pair both seem to be calm, cool, and collected. But beneath Himuro's icy good looks rages a passionate blizzard of love! On the other hand, his coworker's cool facade belies nothing about any feelings she might have for Himuro in return⁠-because she's too oblivious to realize anything! What's a snowman in love to do?

(Source: Square Enix)

Note: Originally uploaded to Twitter, after nine chapters it was serialized by GANGANpixiv, where it is being republished and now continues.
synonyms: Koori Zokusei Danshi to Cool na Douryo Joshi
Ice Attribute Boys and Cool Colleagues Women
บริษัทลุ้นรัก หนุ่มหิมะกับสาวสุดคูล
The Ice Guy and His Cool Female Colleague
冰屬性男子與無表情女子
Chàng băng giá và Nàng lạnh lùng
O Homem de Gelo e sua Fria Colega de Trabalho

title.english: The Ice Guy and the Cool Girl
title.native: 氷属性男子とクールな同僚女子
title.romaji: Koori Zokusei Danshi to Cool na Douryou Joshi

109732.description: Quran is the sacred book of Islam. This manga explores the concept of Quran through the adventure of old Muslim man and Jinn. All faces of prophets are not drawn on this manga in respect of prophets.

109734.description:
How far (or low) can an attractive body take you in a slum? Pretty and well endowed, Choi Hyung-Do scrapes together a living as a waiter by day and porn actor by night. He's occasionally called in for odd jobs at the male brothel where the charismatic owner, Lee Gyung, relentlessly tries to seduce him. Hyung-Do feels as though he’s spiraling, but his attraction to Gyung feels as real as his imminent bankruptcy. The descent may be ruthless, but it's not without its pleasures.

(Source: Lezhin US)

109735.description:
I was forced to let my friend's younger sister live at my place. She doesn't even pay rent or do any of the housework! This isn't fair!

(Source: Toomics)

109736.description:
When magic and wizards are involved in crimes, only another wizard can track them. Join Karol Kings, The Wizard, as he, Sherlock Holmes and Jack the Ripper shape London's history in different ways.

Source: MAL
synonyms: K.K. in the City of Fog

109738.description:
The manga portrays the everyday lives of four young women who love gambling and a self-indulgent lifestyle.

(Source: Anime News Network)

109739.description:
Separated from my lover for 10 years. His phone was piercing me, digging the ground ?! But why does he suddenly look younger ....?

(Source: Random Fujoshis)

Chapter count includes three extras

109740.description:
She finally landed a job as an 'intern' at a train station that's falling apart? But it's a blessing in disguise when an exciting romance arrives!

Chapter count includes prologue and epilogue
synonyms: When Winter Comes to the Way Station

109741.description:
Being the new girl is tough when you have to keep the fact that you're a yomul hunter a secret. Demons with human faces, yomul, run amok in Seoul, and it’s up to Seul Park and her father to destroy them. But her charmed life as a regular high schooler comes under threat when a mysterious and powerful yomul discovers Seul’s biggest secret—she’s half-yomul herself. To make matters worse, he plans to use the cutest boy in school to lure her out of hiding.

(Source: Tapas)

109742.description:
Ice Dancing: a figure skating event that can be explained by its name, dancing on the ice. Because ice dancing involves two people matching their breathing to dance together, their partner is very important.That's why they call meeting the best partner a so-called "miracle." Yoon Hong Joo is uncertain if she would be able to recognize it if it did occur to her. At present, she has her hands full dealing with a partner who is moody and slacks off, that is, until the mysterious Kim Hye Sung comes to her assistance.

Chapter count includes an epilogue

109743.description:
The story is about Miyagawa Shota, who just graduated from high school, and left his hometown to work in the famous Tsurumoku Furniture factory outside of Tokyo. In the company dorm, Shota is roomed with Tabatake, the most senior resident of the dorm and the most obnoxious roommate, and Sugimoto, the in-house Casanova. With these two roommates, Shota is constantly caught in awkward situations.

(Source: manganews.net)

109744.description: Kuria Kei, a chef who was endeavoring to open his first new restaurant in Tokyo found himself in a desert of another world after passing out in the middle of preparations. Rescued by Aisa, a girl who lives in the nearest village to the desert, he started his new life under the care of her family as he developed his cooking skills, and eventually discovered the disquieting food culture held by the citizens of that unfamiliar land.

109746.description:
Puberty.
When you are afraid to talk to girls and you can't be honest.
My childhood friend from two classes above me, is the beautiful and cool "Maka-senpai"
But only I can talk about "magic" with her!!
With a little lie, starts a (not so) magical love comedy!
109746.hashtag: #俺だけにかまって魔可先輩

title.native: 俺だけにかまって魔可先輩

109747.description:
Jeanne d'Arc, a 15th century French war maiden. When the man who followed her and saw all of it was burned at the stake, the corpse changed into a book. The book is called the "Book of Heroes". The "Book of Heroes", which describes great men and people who deserve it, exists all over the world, and fierce battles were fought by those who tried to get them. Battle action fantasy started by an up-and-coming writer living in Kansai !!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

109750.description: A new mission has been assigned to the Orochi subjugation unit, the Yamainu. Could this be—a gag-comedy!? The spin-off of the popular work "Laughing Under the Clouds" by Karakara-sensei has started. The work never ends. Let’s get to work, Yamainu!

109754.description:
In order to learn about human society, a witch transfers to a high school and begins living independently. In class, she meets a boy who can see through her invisibility magic. Their relationship quickly deepens. Can the little witch find the friendship that she’s looking for? Will love blossom?

Includes three side stories.

109755.description:
An Emotionless and strange girl named Yuejin, whose adopted parents went missing one years ago, only left a name card as a clue. Yuejin determined to find her parents by approaching Yan Shen whose name in that name card. However, a ghost who claimed to be her loyal servant of Yuejin popped up from her balcony begging to stay wither her. What life would Yuejin have with this cheeky ghost and a talk cat as pet? Would she meet her parents again?

(Source: MangaToon)

109756.description:
Lychee is an aspiring comic artist, and he dreams to be an assistant to a comic writer. When he steps into the Rainbow Comic Studio, he realizes his artistic career is deemed to be not so…normal?

(Source: MangaToon)

title.native: 我成为了BL漫画家的助理
title.romaji: Wo Chengwei le BL Manhuajia de Zhuli

109757.description:
"Your wish can be granted, for the right price." That is the contract offered by the demon Belial.

This is a record of the time when Yoshino turned 18 years old, which was not depicted in the main story. The time when he transitioned from being her guardian to being her lover.

(Source: Harem, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue and a bonus chapter.

title.native: この愛は、異端。-ベリアル文書-
title.romaji: Kono Ai wa, Itan.: Belial Bunsho

109759.description: Koutarou made a promise with multiple girls when he was younger that he would marry them and the time has come. Chloe and Alicia break into his room while he was asleep and toys with him as he slept. When he woke up to his surprise, both of his childhood friends were sitting on him saying, "Marry me!"

109760.description: 42 year old "shachiku" (company slave) Matsuda Takeshi gets worked to death, as is customary in Japan. His one dying wish is to work for a decent enterprise, not the black company he had been working for. His wish is heard by a god who, for his own amusement, has him reincarnate as a young elf male in another world, with increased affinity for earth magic and ability to command golems. The new golem master sets out on a quest to acquire the Seven Treasures left behind by a legendary mage from 1000 years ago.

title.native: アラフォー社畜のゴーレムマスター

109761.description: Brandon saved Andy's life when they were children, but this heroic act caused him to get epilepsy. After Brandon's family received all the compensation fees they could get out of the tragic accident, his mother and sister moved away, leaving Brandon with his father, who eloped with a co-worker soon afterward. Ten years later, Brandon has found himself stuck with his only friend, Andy, who has been taking care of him, letting him indulge in his drinking problem and satisfying his sexual needs.

109762.description:
Betrayed by her fiancé, Anran Xia (Ariana) flees her wedding, her heart broken and frozen to even the thought of love. Still she rises to the top, as this charismatic beauty buries herself in work. But when her childhood friend suddenly moves back to town, he cheekily creates ripples in her otherwise peaceful life—and in her own home! She’s never imagined being with him, while he’s never imagined being with anyone but her. Can he melt the ice of her long-guarded heart? Sweet romance is on its way!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes two prologues and two epilogues, one per season, and 18 extra chapters.

109766.description: A girl likes to take naps in the school library because no one usually comes there, but a random boy that she has no clue who he is, has been coming in there and playing with her body.

109767.description: Two classmates happen to find each other working together after school for clean-up duty. While cleaning, Tachibana finds a pornographic magazine and asks Mita if they can read it together. They then proceed to re-enact those lewd scenes in the magazine to perfection during their alone time.

title.native: 放課後エクスペリエンス

109768.description: Sunday, the day where you kick back your feet and relax. Naoki is disturbed by his friend Honoka, who came over to play some games with him, but instead, he turned into her own personal chair and she won't leave or stop the game until she completes this one level. So to end his troubles, Naoki grabs her boobs as a trick to make her get off of him, but instead a whole new fiasco starts.

109771.description:
The mangakas' imaginary take on the yuri stories behind famous paintings.

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

109772.description:
"The heroines just keep coming!" They all want one thing from Komoru - for him to join them and be reborn in their fantasy worlds! This homebody doesn't want to go, but when his mother goes off on her own isekai adventure, a goddess comes to take her place as his mom. If he won't go on an adventure, adventure will come to him!

(Source: Mangamo)
synonyms: I'm Not Interested in Your Isekai Fantasy!

title.native: 異世界なんて行くもんか！

109773.description: After a childhood promise made between Mayu and Yuuma about Mayu being Yuuma's future bride. Yuuma forgets about the promise that he made to her and the way she could achieve the promise is by being smarter than him and being nicer then her mom. But as Yuuma forgot about the promise, he gets jealous of her and resorts to violence.

title.native: 脱サラちゃんは癒されたい。

109775.description:
Three chapters of different girls in different sexual relationships with dudes.

Note: Published in Comic Tenma 2005-09, 12, 2006-03, and ChoiS 2007-10, 2008-02

109776.description:
Lin is a Shut, destined to a life of undying love towards one person. Do-Sung is a Destroy, always on edge to hide the violent outbursts they're known for. In this world, it's not just the genetic, but also the psychological traits that distinguish them. Just as Lin is coldly rejected by Do-Sung, a string of horrific murders threatens their lives and the investigation creeps ever closer. Everyone has a secret in this society of differences, but can Lin turn Do-Sung around? The countdown begins in this gripping romance thriller.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes a prologue, epilogue, and 21 side story chapters.

109777.description: Mototsuga was tricked to come back home by his mother from her saying his father had fallen ill, once he arrived home, he was introduced to his new fiancé as it was a planned marriage he was coming to. His mother decided his wife should be, Ayane, a 16 year old girl who is fine with marrying a 32 year old business man. After her introduction to him, his mother drugged his drink with sleeping pills to make him miss the last bus back to his place and force him to stay the night with his new Ayane.

109778.description:
On his first day working as a new teacher at his alma mater, Sunny Day Boys High School, Lee Taesung is welcomed by the bright and sunny smile of Seo Sunny, a warmhearted chemistry teacher. Feeling immediately drawn to Sunny, who resembles his first love from high school, Taesung tries to hold back his feelings by keeping his distance. But still, Taesung can't help but be pulled in by Sunny's irresistible charm*

(Source: TappyToon)

109781.description:
Storm Fairy is a collection of three short stories by legendary mangaka Osamu Tezuka.

In Storm Fairy, an empress flees her burning castle to the nearby forest where she encounters a mischievous forest fairy who grants her wish, for a seemingly small price. It’s not until much later, after she’s given birth to her daughter Ruri, that the empress realizes the true weight of her deal with the fairy. Now the princess, with a face as ugly as sin, must live the rest of her life from behind a mask. When a malcontent discovers Princess Ruri's curse, he plots to overthrow the emperor by masquerading his own daughter as the princess, mask and all. Ruri also meets a lowly ronin and a beautiful fairy who make it their mission to return her to her rightful place on the throne.

In “Kokeshi Detective Agency,” fearless little Pako goes around solving spooky mysteries while her dog Moll does his best to protect her. Oddly enough, Taro, Pako’s scaredy-cat older brother, is forced to accompany Pako on all these scary adventures.

In “Pink Angel,” a sunset cloud named Pink spends an awfully lot of time on the surface helping those who are unhappy or in need. Unfortunately, the rainclouds Sir Brown and Sepia don’t take kindly to Pink’s meddling.

(Source: eManga)
synonyms: Pink no Tenshi (ピンクの天使)

109782.description:
Cyrano de Bergerac, a nobleman serving as a cadet in the French Army is a man of many talents, with a large personality and an even larger nose. An amazing swordsman, he is equally gifted in the areas of poetry and music. However, his brash attitude soon puts him at odds with Chancellor Richelieu and the Compte de Guiche – a couple of ne’er-do-well noblemen who are plotting to overthrow the king.

Meanwhile, Christian, a swordsman from the country, is in Paris. As his friend, Ligniere, is showing him around the city, the pair cross paths with the lovely Roxanne. Although the chivalrous Christian drapes his cloak (along with every other stitch of clothing) over a series of puddles to let Roxanne pass unsullied, he is much too shy to approach her directly.

109783.description:
His passionate gaze makes her wonder if she might be capable of falling in love again.
She’d heard the rumors but had no idea someone could be this handsome! At an interview for one of the most prominent real estate agencies in England, Toni George was shocked by the presence of the agency’s owner, Steel Landry. Still, she didn’t let herself succumb to his charm or wit. Due to unforeseen circumstances, she was in financial debt and forced to work under this impressive man. To her dismay, he kept asking questions about her personal life until she opened up about her family and her past. Just when she thought the job must have slipped between her fingers and things couldn’t get any worse, he said something that caught her completely by surprise…

(Source: Harlequin)

Before the hero, Graham, goes on his journey to defeat the demon lord, he asks his beloved Louisa to promise to wait for his return. He is both her childhood friend and beau. Except, she has no intention of waiting for him at all. The truth is, she's been reincarnated three times, and all three times the heroes were always her childhood friend and boyfriend. And every single time they went on their journeys to fight evil, they found someone else and never came back to her! So, she's never waiting for any hero again, and in this life time she's going find happiness somewhere else! A fantasy about a super independent girl!

His attempts at making friends aren't going so well until he meets someone who recognizes him—friendly and laidback Junpei, who went to the same high school as he did. It is a collaboration between Masashi Kishimoto, author of Naruto, and Kenji Taira, author of Rock Lee's Springtime of Youth Full Power Ninja Chronicles and Sasuke Uchiha's Sharingan Legend. In the Kishimoto portion, Mitsuki discusses the heritage of the members of Team Konohamaru. In the Taira portion, Konohamaru gives his team a bell test.

Kenji Taira's portion is included as a bonus Mini Manga 3 in Volume 2 of Sasuke Uchiha's Sharingan Legend.

Icy is an average Jane. She professed her love for her Mr. McDreamy that she had secretly loved for many years. But, the agent made a mistake about her gender and signed the contract with her. Icy cannot afford the penalty. Together with the agent and company, they lied to the whole entertainment industry. Everything went smoother and smoother and she also met someone that worth spending rest of her life with. She told him everything, but the man is a total liar? Tezuka’s undersea adventure, Pippy (1951-53) was originally serialized in Shuiesha’s Funny Book from December 1951 to May 1953, with a one-off Pippy side-story, “Pippy’s Adventure”, appearing in an Funny Book “Special Issue” in August 1952.

With human overpopulation quickly becoming an immense problem, Dr. Lehman decides the best idea is for humanity to live in the sea. After his idea is ridiculed, he decides to experiment on his newborn son, turning him into the world’s first mer-person. However, believing his son has died as a result of the experiment, Dr. Lehman and his wife commit his body to the sea, just as an angry mob – complete with pick axes and lawn rakes – shows up on their doorstep, demanding to know where the child is. The pair is convicted of murder and sentenced to prison.

109814.description:

During his stint with the humans, Leo has many learning experiences and somehow always manages to get into a little trouble along the way. But when a rat arrives—carried by a stork like a little bundle of joy, no less—with a message from home, Leo realizes it’s time to return to the jungle. As he embarks on his biggest adventure yet, he’s unaware of the great battles that lie ahead.

As a businessman with prior experience in such matters, Joohyuk agrees to help... but he wants something physical in return?!

When he wakes, he finds himself chained up in the house of Shin Jooin, the clean-cut man who apparently rescued him. But there's something off about Jooin, who treats May almost like a pet* Who is Jooin really, and what is he hiding?

109827.description:
A group of high school friends have a tradition that they continue to honour even as adults: an annual Christmas gift exchange. Nam Yoontae is handsome, popular, easy-going, and the womaniser of the group. Nerdy, bespectacled Seong Chan, who only ended up with a gang of boys his polar opposite because they needed his help getting through exams, has been harbouring a secret crush for the other man since their schooldays.

Seong Chan dutifully attends the gift exchange every year for one reason, and one reason only: to have Yoontae receive his gift. But this Christmas, it seems that something even more shocking it about to happen.

109836.description:
The earliest incarnation of what would eventually become Tezuka’s epic masterpiece, Phoenix [Manga Shonen] (1954-55) was Tezuka’s follow-up series to the popular Jungle Emperor (1950-54) in Manga Shonen. It began publication in July 1954 and ran until the magazine suddenly folded in May 1955, unfortunately leaving the work unfinished after just eight instalments.

In a mythical age of ancient Japan, Nagi Iza, a young boy living on one of the southern islands, is on a quest to find the legendary Phoenix and save his dying father. Believing the magical healing properties of the blood of the mysterious bird is the only way to cure his father, Nagi sets off on a mission to climb up Fire Mountain, a local volcano and the home of the Phoenix.

109847.description: Kuri-chan (クリちゃん) is a yonkoma manga series by Susumu Nemoto which ran from October 1, 1951 to March 31, 1965 in the Asahi Shimbun evening edition. Nemoto modeled the main character, Kuri-chan, after his oldest son who was born in 1948. The name of the main character is actually Ken (健), and gets his nickname from his naturally "kuri kuri" (or "curly") hair. The manga is unusual in that, other than the images, it relies almost exclusively on onomotopeia rather than words to tell the story. In that regard it has been classified as a pantomime comic.

However, he who has pursued strength his whole life has lost sight of his goal from taking down a monster of the strongest species. As he worried about what to do next in his life, it was the scenery of Nordende that popped up in his mind; A rural village by the countryside, full of natural beauty, which he only visited once during a quest in the past.

After declaring the disbandment of his party, he heads towards Nordende for a comfortable, relaxing life.

Then, he met Felix. Shy and seemingly innocent, Felix’s touch is the first heat Giovanni’s felt in a lifetime. I wish I could dissect you, my favorite idol. You are so beautiful, and I love all of you, even your internal organs.

No matter where you run, blood and guts will splatter in this fetishistic masterpiece from the master of gore, Kaburagi Saiko.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

The Return of the Hanging Balloons

I'm Currently Becoming The Demon Lord
I'm A Middle Schooler Becoming The Demon Lord

109864.description: "Romance and so on, it's impossible to predict". The childhood friend of the main character loves him. What will happen when she confessess her feelings to him? Will the main character be able to see his childhood friend as something more than a friend? The "I can't see her as a romantic interest" trope is taken to the maximum level in this oneshot, while focusing on a surreal type of comedy.

109865.description:
Seo-U Jeong (Sebastian Jung) was the hottest teacher, that is, until I-Geon Han (Isaac Han) arrived. Tall, intelligent, and beautifully brooding, I-Geon has it all and Seo-U knows this all too well. In the past, they had shared a sultry after school romance. Now, I-Geon is back. Can Seo-U resist falling for I-Geon again or will his lips yearn for his touch?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

109866.description: Youth is so embarrassing that she wants to die! An elegy of a completely “self-conscious” person. Being too focused on what other people think of her... will Asukawa be able to spend her time in high school safely?!

title.native: 死なないで！明日川さん

109868.description:
Nakano moves to Tokyo to begin her life as a university student. The night she moves in, she's troubled by the weird noises coming from the flat next door. When she introduces herself to her neighbor, she's shocked to see that the source of the weird noises was... two women?! The story of a naive girl caught up in the erotic love between women.

Note: Chapter count contains 2 bonus chapters.
synonyms: There's Weird Voices Coming from the Room Next Door!

109872.description: Santaro is a young man who's obsessed with cute girls and winning them over. He sets his sights on a girl named Chiyoko, and aims to be her boyfriend by driving away whatever competition he has.

109873.description: After her father expected to stop the war with his neighbors and accepted the marriage application of the neighboring country, Princess Ella went to the neighboring country to become the wife of the first prince. However, there is a terrible rumor in neighboring countries. No one who has married into the royal family will come out again after entering the city. With uneasiness and curiosity about the first prince, Ella went to a neighboring country...

title.romaji: Eila to Totsu Kuni no Ou

109874.description:
In a world that everyone only wants to kill, where everyone mocks doctors for being cowardice. Then, I'm going to be the most powerful doctor in the future of this crazy world! Medicine dominates the world!

(Source: WebComics)
